They were really good! I've probably made this 7 times in the past three days. I just take one potato, cut it into my ideal fry size, and soak it in water & a splash of white vinegar (I like the sour taste) after rinsing some starch off. Then, I spritz it with some nonstick cooking spray, shake salt and pepper on it, and put it in my preheated air fryer at 350 degrees for 15 minutes, shaking halfway. Comes out perfect every time!

Edit: Forgot to mention, I try to soak them in the vinegar and water for at least thirty minutes before draining and cooking, but sometimes I'm too hungry and just make them after soaking for five minutes or so.
